name: @ksilvennoinen/markov-namegen
description: Markov chain based name generator in TypeScript
author: Kari Silvennoinen

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['dist', '.tsbuildinfo', '.tsbuildinfo.cjs', '.tsbuildinfo.esm', '.tsbuildinfo.test', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/write-esm-package.mjs
